line: Your n8n workflow can fail completely — and still say "Success."
One setting causes it: On Error, set to Continue — built to survive a small hiccup.
But when a node actually fails, n8n doesn't flag the workflow at all.
The Executions list still reads green. Success. Every single time.
The only place it shows is inside that node's own output — buried in error data nobody opens.
Real case, from n8n's own community: a workflow silently stopped working for weeks, and the log insisted it was fine.
One extra step catches it — a branch that checks for the error field, and alerts you the moment it appears.
The exact setup's in the link in bio.
Follow for the setup that actually works.
